title: CCI Clears GRT Jewellers' Rs 1,033.71 Crore Majority Stake Buy in Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri
case_name: Combination registered by GRT Jewellers (India) Private Limited for acquisition of Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited
citation: CCI approval disclosed by TBZ to stock exchanges on 13 October 2026; detailed order awaited
card_summary: The Competition Commission of India approved GRT Jewellers' proposed buy of a 74.12% stake in listed jeweller Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri, finding no competition concerns. The clearance follows GRT's 31 August 2026 share purchase agreement for up to Rs 1,033.71 crore, with the promoter stake priced at Rs 209 a share and a public open offer at Rs 249.61 a share. TBZ disclosed the approval on 13 October 2026.
card_tip: Treat a CCI 'approval' disclosed before the detailed order is released as one closing condition cleared, not completion; check the share purchase agreement for the other conditions precedent before advising on timelines.
verification_notes: The CCI clearance and its disclosure date (13 October 2026) are consistent across LiveLawBiz and several market-news outlets (Kotak Neo, DSIJ, Business Today, Deccan Chronicle), which independently of each other report the same stake percentage, deal value and open-offer price. The CCI's own detailed order was not available in the sources reviewed, so no CCI case number is given.
